description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
